entries.back_en: Soldier, please, do not let anything happen to her. She's the most precious thing I have...
EDIL, I'M HERE! PLEASE, SAY SOMETHING!
I'm so sorry, Edil... I shouldn't have left your side.
entries.note: 'deixado seu lado' is awkward; better 'saído do seu lado'.

entries.back_en: East of Hafin, across the plains, you'll find a small orchard with green flowers at the centre: it's called Lilis Radiantis.
They... These are no simple flowers. With them, you'll be able to destroy the agent keeping her in this state.
Hurry, we don't know how much longer they'll stay like this. And be careful, we're managing to defend the city, but those things will surely be roaming the surrounding area.
You prepared me for anything, including something like this!
